propositions: Hand-maintained package help artifacts drift from runtime parser factories and contain stale/incorrect option descriptions; canonical help must be generated from immutable registry and enriched parser definitions.

Help output is non-deterministic and rendered through intercept-only routes; a pre-scan lexical routing stage must serve committed generated artifacts before operation composition, config parsing, or handler resolution.
Factory descriptions lack enriched argument help text (description, epilog, SUPPRESS); enrichment must be added to core and advanced parsers so generated help renders true grammar.

Overview grouping, alias deduplication, hidden/compatibility routing, and per-command one-liner coverage are undefined or inconsistent; generation must enforce determinism, enforce non-blank summaries via --check failure, and apply approved annotation rules.

Help artifact bodies must be regenerated from post-S2b/S2c factory grammar with the capitalized Usage: prefix preserved byte-for-byte; all hand-authored usage tables and option descriptions are replaced by factory-rendered content.
